units.source_text: 这女人不是向自己的家走去。

en.t: This woman was not walking toward her own home.

units.source_text: 为了说话，她漫无目标地绕着行人稀少的背胡同行走。

en.t: In order to talk, she wandered aimlessly through the back alleys where there were few passersby.

units.source_text: 因此好不容易来到女人独居的住所前面时，我已弄不清这儿究竟是哪一带市街的一角了。

en.t: So by the time we finally arrived in front of the place where the woman lived alone, I could no longer tell what part of the city this corner belonged to.
